## RLM chat
- Stop the Prime daemon before restarting after an update, reducing the risk of a previous process retaining an RLM session lock.
- Explain when an RLM session is already open in another Prime process, without exposing private diagnostic details.

## Known limits
- The restart and session recovery have not yet been verified manually in the application. An existing session lock may require quitting Claake Code completely before reopening it.
